liquidity.notes: Escrowed USDT across 90 fiat markets. Headline = depth priced within ±5% of the FX mid ($27.08M); the full observed book is $47.85M but includes ads priced 30%+ from mid that can never fill. USD/EUR are probed to full book depth; other markets up to 100 ads (5-page adaptive).

volume_30d_usd.notes: Binance does not separately disclose P2P volume

assumptions.asset_selection: cheapest qualifying fill across USDT and USDC; USDT won this cycle
assumptions.match_rule: best-priced ad accepting a $1000 single tx with ≥$1000 USDT-side capacity
assumptions.payment_method_fee: assumed 0 — on P2P the fiat moves bank-to-bank between taker and maker and the venue never touches it. Card/e-wallet rails can carry a third-party fee we cannot observe per-ad.
assumptions.venue_fee: flat taker fee per trade order on USDT pairs, 0.06–0.08 USDT depending on market (midpoint assumed) since 2025-09-22 — we assume 0.07 USDT. The per-fiat MAKER fee is not itemized: it is embedded in the quoted price and therefore already inside the maker spread.
assumptions.maker_spread: matched ad price vs the FX mid — the maker sets the price, the venue does not quote it. Negative means the book prices under mid, paying the taker.
assumptions.withdrawal_fee: USDT withdrawal to BNB Smart Chain (BEP20) (0.01 USDT; network-dependent: 0.01 (BEP20) to 1.5 (TRC20) USDT; ERC20 0.4, Solana 0.3; checked 2026-07-21) — the quoted journey ends in your own wallet, so this is included in the total.

assumptions.asset_selection: cheapest qualifying fill across USDT and USDC; USDT won this cycle
assumptions.match_rule: median of the top-5 best-paying qualifying ads (outlier-resistant: best SELL prices are often reversible-payment risk premiums)
assumptions.payment_method_fee: assumed 0 — on P2P the fiat moves bank-to-bank between taker and maker and the venue never touches it. Card/e-wallet rails can carry a third-party fee we cannot observe per-ad.
assumptions.venue_fee: flat taker fee per trade order on USDT pairs, 0.06–0.08 USDT depending on market (midpoint assumed) since 2025-09-22 — we assume 0.07 USDT. The per-fiat MAKER fee is not itemized: it is embedded in the quoted price and therefore already inside the maker spread.
assumptions.maker_spread: matched ad price vs the FX mid — the maker sets the price, the venue does not quote it. Negative means the book prices under mid, paying the taker.
assumptions.withdrawal_fee: 0 — the venue charges nothing to receive a deposit. Chain gas to send USDT in is paid to the network, not the venue, and varies by chain.

cost_1k.notes: Spread legs are live $1k single-match quotes vs the CoinGecko FX mid; the optional exit-to-chain line uses Binance’s published withdrawal schedule (hand-checked).

markets.notes: Top 10 deepest markets (by USDT depth in top-20 ad slice), filtered to those with FX mids available.

depth_composition.notes: Per-fiat share of USDT escrow observed in the top-20 BUY ad slice across 90 fiat markets. Snapshot, not a window — Binance doesn't publish historical volume.

network_health.notes: Maker-reputation aggregates across distinct advertisers seen in the top-20 slice of every probed market. Snapshot of currently-posting makers, not a 30d window.
